# Captured fixtures — GTKWave `.gtkw` session saves

This directory holds real GTKWave save files acquired from public open-source
projects. They complement the deterministic synthetic saves next door in
`../generated/` by exercising the `.gtkw` parser and importer against
real-world files — saves written by actual GTKWave installations, full of
directives WaveCrux does not model (`[*]` banner lines, `[dumpfile_mtime]`,
`[dumpfile_size]`, `[savefile]`, `[size]`, `[pos]`, `[sst_width]`,
`[signals_width]`, `[sst_expanded]`, `[sst_vpaned_height]`, `[pattern_trace]`).
The parser must silently skip every one of those and still recover the signal
list, groups, colors, formats, and markers. The committed `.expected_parse.json`
goldens lock that behavior.

Unlike a decoder capture, no waveform dumpfile is committed for these saves
(they reference absolute paths on the original author's machine), so there is
no `.expected_session.json` import golden here — the golden test instead
verifies the parse output and asserts that importing against an empty variable
set is non-fatal (every signal lands in `unmatchedSignalPaths`).

## License allow-list

Captured fixtures must come from projects under one of these licenses:

- MIT
- BSD-2-Clause / BSD-3-Clause
- Apache-2.0
- ISC
- CC0-1.0
- public domain

GPL/AGPL/proprietary saves are excluded by policy — note in particular that
GTKWave's own bundled `examples/*.gtkw` are GPL and therefore NOT eligible.
The static test `test/static/gtkw_captured_fixture_licenses_test.dart` walks
this `PROVENANCE.md` and fails the build if any entry uses a license outside
this list, or if any `.gtkw` file in this directory has no matching entry.

- **Hand-verified anchors:**

- **Snapshot regenerated by:** `dart run tool/generate_gtkw_fixtures.dart`

## `sonata_ibex_pc_gpo.gtkw` — lowRISC Sonata SoC: Ibex core PC + GPIO, with a colored clock and an FST dumpfile

- **Source project:** lowRISC/sonata-system — <https://github.com/lowRISC/sonata-system>
- **Source commit:** `219a61c99cb0b88849f164dc411e7c07a6e5b129` (acquired 2026-06-08)
- **License:** Apache-2.0 (SPDX: `Apache-2.0`)
- **Author / maintainer:** lowRISC contributors
- **Original location:** `data/pc_and_gpo.gtkw`
- **Capture method:** direct `.gtkw` from repo, committed verbatim.
- **Size:** 1071 bytes
- **What it exercises:** A Verilator-produced FST dumpfile (`./sim.fst`), seven nested `[treeopen]` scopes down into the Ibex core, a `[color] 1` (red) directive on the clock, and vector signals with bit-range suffixes in octal (`@22`) and hex (`@28`). Confirms the parser ignores `[size]`/`[pos]`/`[sst_*]`/`[pattern_trace]`/`[savefile]`/`[dumpfile_mtime]`/`[dumpfile_size]` while recovering the rest.
- **Hand-verified anchors:**
  - `[dumpfile]` resolves to `./sim.fst`; `[timestart]` is 5093.
  - Named marker `a` sits at tick 3723 (slot 1 of the `*` line).
  - Three signal traces: `clk_sys_i` (colored red), `gp_o[23:0]` (octal), and the deep `…wb_stage_i.pc_wb_o[31:0]`.
- **Snapshot regenerated by:** `dart run tool/generate_gtkw_fixtures.dart`

## `uart_rx_tx.gtkw` — ben-marshall/uart: three named groups (Top Level / UART RX / UART TX) over 39 signals

- **Source project:** ben-marshall/uart — <https://github.com/ben-marshall/uart>
- **Source commit:** `9c7fac16ed957e9cb6fb0ad0295551762715bea6` (acquired 2026-06-08)
- **License:** MIT (SPDX: `MIT`)
- **Author / maintainer:** Ben Marshall
- **Original location:** `bin/waves-view.gtkw`
- **Capture method:** direct `.gtkw` from repo, committed verbatim.
- **Size:** 1772 bytes
- **What it exercises:** The group-heavy case — three `@800200`/`@1000200` begin/end group pairs ("Top Level", "UART RX", "UART TX") wrapping 39 signal traces, mixing scalar (`@28`) and vector (`@22`) formats. This is the captured-tier proof that real GTKWave group markers reconstruct into nested `SignalGroup`s.
- **Hand-verified anchors:**
  - Three group-begin / three group-end markers named "Top Level", "UART RX", "UART TX".
  - `[dumpfile]` is `/home/ben/projects/arty/uart/waves.vcd`; `[timestart]` is 29200; marker `a` at tick 81110.
  - First grouped signal is `tb.bytes[7:0]`.
- **Snapshot regenerated by:** `dart run tool/generate_gtkw_fixtures.dart`

## `fpxx_adder.gtkw` — tomverbeure/math: separator-heavy floating-point adder view with a "(null)" dumpfile

- **Source project:** tomverbeure/math — <https://github.com/tomverbeure/math>
- **Source commit:** `7f2c455c29d8c365c0d089995c327eb9f9b42c0c` (acquired 2026-06-08)
- **License:** BSD-2-Clause (SPDX: `BSD-2-Clause`)
- **Author / maintainer:** Tom Verbeure
- **Original location:** `wavesFpxxAdd.gtkw`
- **Capture method:** direct `.gtkw` from repo, committed verbatim.
- **Size:** 1210 bytes
- **What it exercises:** A save with no dumpfile loaded (`[dumpfile] "(null)"`), large `[timestart]`/marker tick values (~1.19e7), and six blank-separator rows produced by `@200`/`-` pairs interleaved between signal groups. Confirms `@`-flag words with neither group bit set produce separators, and that a literal `"(null)"` dumpfile string is preserved verbatim rather than misread.
- **Hand-verified anchors:**
  - `[dumpfile]` is the literal string `(null)`; `[timestart]` is 11871460; marker `a` at tick 11871605.
  - 18 signal traces and 6 separators, no groups.
  - First signal is `TOP.FpxxAddDut.fp_op.reset`.
- **Snapshot regenerated by:** `dart run tool/generate_gtkw_fixtures.dart`

## `bubble_fifo.gtkw` — schoeberl/chisel-examples: Chisel-generated BubbleFifo with a VCD dumpfile

- **Source project:** schoeberl/chisel-examples — <https://github.com/schoeberl/chisel-examples>
- **Source commit:** `8927a4bb1471741a802ad93a4025595893b428a1` (acquired 2026-06-08)
- **License:** BSD-2-Clause (SPDX: `BSD-2-Clause`)
- **Author / maintainer:** Martin Schoeberl
- **Original location:** `bubble.gtkw`
- **Capture method:** direct `.gtkw` from repo, committed verbatim.
- **Size:** 819 bytes
- **What it exercises:** A small, flat save over a Chisel-generated VCD (`generated/BubbleFifo.vcd`) with Chisel's characteristic `Module_N.signal` naming, a single `[treeopen]`, no groups, no markers, and a mix of scalar (`@28`, `@29`) and 8-bit-vector (`@22`) formats. The minimal baseline real-world capture.
- **Hand-verified anchors:**
  - `[dumpfile]` is `generated/BubbleFifo.vcd`; `[timestart]` is 0; no named markers.
  - 11 signal traces, no groups, no separators.
  - First signal is `BubbleFifo.clk`; the FIFO register stages appear as `BubbleFifo.FifoRegister_N.dataReg[7:0]`.
- **Snapshot regenerated by:** `dart run tool/generate_gtkw_fixtures.dart`
